name: no stored object of an encrypted drive holds a file's plaintext
description: KOOFR-013 (Koofr desktop pointed at a Vault Safe Box): it downloaded ciphertext with random names and uploaded local files unencrypted into the encrypted folder. Rules I1 and S15: an encrypted drive holds only AZL1 objects; plaintext never reaches it and a client without the key syncs nothing. sync-chaos crypto-no-plaintext-no-dedup.
